feedback.resolution.responseHint: Explain what you changed or why you disagree.
feedback.resolution.reason: Reason for this action (shared with the creator)
feedback.resolution.restrictedHint: You can read moderation decisions and request a review here.
feedback.copyright.disclosure: This is a formal legal submission. Your statement and contact details may be forwarded to the other party where required by the copyright process.
feedback.copyright.location: Exact URL of the reported material, or its location before removal
feedback.copyright.explanation: Identify the copyrighted work and explain the alleged infringement, or explain why removal was a mistake
feedback.copyright.signature: Electronic signature (type your full legal name)
feedback.copyright.noticeDeclaration: I believe the reported use lacks permission from the rights holder or their representative and is not permitted by law. I confirm that this notice is accurate and declare, under penalty of perjury, that I am authorized to act for the owner of the exclusive right allegedly infringed.
feedback.copyright.counterDeclaration: Under penalty of perjury, I believe the material was removed or disabled because of a mistake or misidentification. I consent to the jurisdiction of the Federal District Court for my address, or, if outside the United States, a district where the service provider may be found. I will accept service of process from the original notifier or their agent.
feedback.resolution.retentionUntil: Erase case personal data after this date (closed cases only)
feedback.resolution.legalHold: Preserve this case for legal proceedings
feedback.copyright.forwarded: Date forwarded to the original notifier
feedback.copyright.earliest: Earliest restoration date (10 business days after receipt)
feedback.copyright.deadline: Restoration deadline (14 business days after receipt)
feedback.copyright.calendarHint: Verify the applicable business-day calendar before setting restoration dates. Dates and forwarding time are recorded in UTC. Record forwarding only after it has occurred.
feedback.copyright.invalid: Check the contact details, URL, explanation and signature, and confirm the declaration. If submission still fails, try again.
feedback.resolution.decisionReason: Decision reasons (shared with the affected creator)
feedback.resolution.decisionHint: State the policy or legal basis, relevant facts, restriction scope and duration, and how to request review.
feedback.resolution.privacyReview: An account was deleted. Review retained case text and legal holds before scheduling erasure.
